care.d: An automatic that sits in a drawer stops. Thirty manual winds brings it back to life.
Fresh water, then dry with a soft cloth. Salt eats gaskets faster than anything.
10 ATM means swimming. It doesn't mean unscrewing the crown while the case is wet.
Gaskets harden. Send it back and we'll swap them and retest, parts at cost.

faq.a: We use genuine Seiko automatic movements for uncompromised reliability. To create a unique, luxury aesthetic, components like the dial, hands, bezel, and crystal are custom-made aftermarket parts expertly fitted by hand. It is a bespoke horological creation, not a mass-produced factory Seiko—and we hold ourselves to that distinction.

faq.q: Will it still be water resistant?
faq.a: Yes. Every Seiko mod is pressure-tested to 10 ATM after assembly. If a test fails, the watch goes back on the bench, not into a box. Other watches keep their factory rating, listed on each card.

faq.q: How long does a custom order take?
faq.a: Typically 10–14 business days. We value open communication: if any specific custom part requires extra lead time, we inform you before any payment is made, ensuring your expectations are always met.
For Seiko mods: twelve months on the movement and the seals. Accidental damage and normal wear on straps aren’t covered. For other watches, ask us before you buy.

faq.q: Can you mod a watch I already own?
faq.a: Yes. Message us on Telegram with photos and what you want changed, and we’ll quote parts and labour separately.
Yes. The G-Shocks in the shop are original Casio and carry an Original Casio label on their card. If we ever modify one, the card says Mod, not Original.
Watch brands sold under their own names, with the brand on the dial and on the card. They aren’t mods, and we don’t present them as anything else.
Tap Order on any watch to message us on Telegram with its reference code, like PD-03. We reply with stock, colours and delivery.
JH73+JGC, Preah Sihanouk 18010. Open Everyday · 10:00–22:00. Message ahead if you want to see a specific watch.

anatomy.d: Sourced brand new, deep-cleaned, and fitted with fresh premium gaskets before a single component is touched.
NH35A automatic movement with hacking and hand-winding, regulated on a professional timegrapher to a strict $\pm10$ s/day accuracy.
Tailored entirely to your taste—choose between sunburst, matte, or hand-painted finishes elevated with high-grade C3 or BGW9 Swiss Super-LumiNova.
Precision-pressed using specialized fitting tools and rigorously checked at every position for flawless gear clearance.
Aligned perfectly with the dial tracks. Because in fine horology, even a fraction of a millimeter misalignment is unacceptable.
Double-domed sapphire crystal with anti-reflective (AR) coating, paired with high-tech ceramic or steel inserts, hydraulic-seated for absolute structural integrity.
Fitted to perfection, then subjected to rigorous dry and wet pressure testing before receiving its final seal of approval and luxury boxing.
